create_sampler: create a Sampler instance with max_num_reqs, vocab_size, device, req_states, and logprobs_mode for GPU-based token sampling
add_request_sampler: add a request to the Sampler with req_idx, prompt_len, and SamplingParams to register sampling state
call_sampler: call the Sampler with logits and InputBatch to produce sampled token ids, logprobs, and nan counts
apply_sampling_params: apply logit bias, penalties, bad words masking, temperature, min_p, and top_k/top_p to logits in place
sample_tokens: sample next tokens from processed logits using Gumbel-Top-K sampling with per-request temperature and seeds
